journeys.title: Workforce User IAP + MFA Authentication & Role Membership Journey
journeys.evidenceSummary: GCP IAP subject verification passed; SoD self-grant blocked with 403 Forbidden (code: IAM_SOD_VIOLATION); Break-glass activated with 15-min auto-expiry TTL (900s).

steps.detail: x-goog-authenticated-user-email: [REDACTED_ADMIN_USER]@drts-fleet.internal verified against Google public key ring.
Throws ApiRequestError (code: IAM_SOD_VIOLATION, 'Requester cannot approve their own privileged role grant (Separation of Duties violation).'). SoD check blocks self-approval.
Break-glass session activated with 15-min TTL (900s); logged to append-only security audit stream.

journeys.title: Tenant OIDC + MFA Login, Invitation & Governance Enforcement Journey
journeys.evidenceSummary: OIDC PKCE token exchange verified; cost-center directory isolation and approval governance fail-closed rules enforced.

steps.action: OIDC PKCE Exchange & Session Cookie Setup
steps.detail: OIDC PKCE code exchange completed; secure session cookie set for tenant admin; replayed state throws AUTH_SESSION_EXCHANGE_DENIED.
Unknown or cross-tenant cost center lookup returns COST_CENTER_UNKNOWN and preserves validation audit evidence.
Fails closed on quota_insufficient without leaving behind orphan booking or quota residue.

journeys.title: Tenant Admin Role Elevation & Step-Up MFA / Session Invalidation Journey
journeys.evidenceSummary: Role elevation requires step-up TOTP verification (code: IAM_STEP_UP_REQUIRED); last-admin demotion blocked with 409 Conflict (code: IAM_LAST_ADMIN_PROTECTION); cross-tenant access denied (code: AUTHZ_SCOPE_DENIED).

steps.detail: Throws ApiRequestError (code: IAM_STEP_UP_REQUIRED, 'Fresh MFA or step-up verification required for privileged role operation.').
Throws ApiRequestError (code: IAM_LAST_ADMIN_PROTECTION, 'Cannot remove or demote the last active admin for the organization/tenant.'). Prevents tenant lockout.
Throws ApiRequestError (code: AUTHZ_SCOPE_DENIED) on cross-tenant resource access attempt.

journeys.title: Driver Device Binding & Refresh Token Family Revocation Journey
journeys.evidenceSummary: Driver device binding established; mobile refresh token family active; refresh token replay triggers automatic family revocation in <0.6s.

steps.detail: Bound driver identity to mobile device with hardware-bound fingerprint.
Replay of previously consumed refresh token revokes full refresh family (rf_family_*) and active sessions across node cluster.

journeys.title: Partner API Key Ingress, Dual Overlap Rotation & Expiry Journey
journeys.evidenceSummary: Partner API key authenticated; dual key overlap rotation supported; expired/revoked partner key fails closed with TENANT_API_KEY_EXPIRY_PAST / PARTNER_API_KEY_REVOKED.

steps.detail: x-partner-api-key: [REDACTED_PARTNER_KEY] validated against partner credential registry.
Rotated to new key kid_2026_q3 while keeping previous key valid during 48h overlap window.
Throws ApiRequestError (code: TENANT_API_KEY_EXPIRY_PAST). Access rejected immediately.

journeys.title: User Offboarding, Session, Key & Device Revocation Journey
journeys.evidenceSummary: User offboarding / access removal immediately invalidates all active sessions, API keys, device bindings, and logs decision to audit stream.

steps.detail: Revoked all active sessions and device bindings for target principal upon access review removal decision.

journeys.title: Break-Glass Request, Different Approver & Post-Use Review Journey
journeys.evidenceSummary: Break-glass request created; self-approval blocked with 403 Forbidden (code: AUTH_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, 'Requester cannot approve their own break-glass request.'); approved by distinct secondary approver; active session created with 15-min TTL.

steps.detail: Emergency request registered with justification and requested elevation duration.
Throws ApiRequestError (code: AUTH_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, 'Requester cannot approve their own break-glass request.'). SoD guard enforced.
Approved by distinct secondary approver; active break-glass session created with 900s auto-expiry TTL.
